name: Max Heights Infrastructure Limited
about: Max Heights Infrastructure Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in real estate development and financing activities in India. The company operates through three segments: Financing of Vehicles and Other Finance; Real Estate Business; and Dealing in Stock and Shares. It also engages in identification, acquisition, planning, execution, construction, and marketing of residential, commercial, industrial, and mixed-use properties; retail, office spaces; hotels; and township projects. In addition, it is involved in the leasing, maintenance, and recreational activities related to real estate. Max Heights Infrastructure Limited was incorporated in 1981 and is based in New Delhi, India.
